description: First-60-seconds repo orientation for agents and developers. Composes setup diagnostics, workplan, quality scorecard, adoption gaps, top risks, and next commands into one read-only workflow recommendation.

include_handoff.description: Include a compact handoff payload for the next agent.

intent.description: Plain-language goal to route into the next best action and proof commands.

max_risks.description: Maximum top risks to return. Default: 5, max: 12.

max_tasks.description: Maximum workplan tasks to inspect. Default: 5, max: 12.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

mission_dir.description: Optional saved Mission Control bundle directory. When set, start includes proof outcome from proof-logs/summary.json.

mode.description: Workflow mode to orient around. Default: before_edit.

name: projscan_start
